evidence.quote: During its last quarterly conference call, management forecast that it expects hyperscaler spending to top $1 trillion in 2027 after reaching a projected $650 billion in 2026 .
evidence.one_line: Management forecast hyperscaler spending above $1 trillion in 2027, following projected spending of $650 billion in 2026.
evidence.speaker: The Motley Fool author reporting management's forecast on a quarterly conference call
evidence.original_who: Management (not further identified in the item)

evidence.quote: For the rest of this year, they expect 82% growth. For 2027, that figure rises to 41%.
evidence.one_line: The author said Wall Street analysts expected 82% growth for the rest of 2026 and 41% growth in 2027; the growth measure is not specified in the item.
evidence.speaker: The Motley Fool author, attributing the estimates to Wall Street analysts
evidence.original_who: Wall Street analysts (not further identified in the item)

evidence.quote: For fiscal 2028, ending January 2028, the average analyst projects $12.76 in earnings per share.
evidence.one_line: The author reported that the average analyst projected $12.76 in Nvidia earnings per share for FY2028, ending January 2028.
evidence.speaker: The Motley Fool author, attributing the estimate to the average analyst
evidence.original_who: The average analyst (not further identified in the item)

evidence.quote: If we use that figure and value the stock at a reasonable earnings multiple of 25, the projected share price at the end of fiscal 2028 is $319.
evidence.one_line: The author projected an Nvidia share price of $319 at the end of FY2028, using $12.76 EPS and a 25-times earnings multiple.
evidence.speaker: The Motley Fool author

evidence.quote: So I think the stock could easily reach $300 per share sometime in late 2027.
